name: pcb-minimist-core
description: Faithful-core prototype-pollution guard using the REAL npm `minimist` CLI arg-parser per version (pre-guard 1.2.1 -> __proto__ string guard 1.2.5 [CVE-2020-7598 fix, still bypassable via constructor.prototype] -> isConstructorOrProto 1.2.6 [CVE-2021-44906 fix]). npm aliases hold all three versions side-by-side; the harness selects one by HARNESS_VER and drives the REAL published minimist() setKey() on the crafted argv.
